description_en: Deletes cloud-stored pictures in batches by picture IDs for a specified IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口，批量删除指定IPC设备下指定图片ID的云端图片
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual delete-picture --picture-id-list example-string --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id 1CJ00000e7qiq8VkQi1000000 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletePicture

parameters.description_en:
The list of picture IDs. Picture IDs are generated when you call [TriggerCapturePicture](~~107914~~).

> A maximum of 50 picture IDs can be specified in a single call.
parameters.description_zh:
图片ID列表。图片ID由调用[TriggerCapturePicture](~~107914~~)时生成。

> 单次调用最多支持输入50个图片ID。

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page of the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to query the information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>

parameters.name: device_name

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify **IotId** together with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance overview](~~356505~~).
